Our sex life has gradually diminished to once every 10 days, she has gained 30lbs. from a year ago.  She isn't happy about her weight gain, but hasn't done anything.  She isn't pregnant, and is a 12 credit per semester college student.  

She has complained about stress, so I have been splitting up the cooking duties, and have always been active in the house work.  I get upset when she says stress because I work about 45 hours a week, with a 1 hour commute each way, and am studying for a professional certification, and yet things keep adding up.  Above all, I am starting to get some resentment for our situation, and need some help.  I don't want to resent this situation or my wife.  Therapy is the easy answer, but that is more financial strain, and we've been there before our marriage, and it just feels like I'm the one changing.  

Alright, enough ranting, what is the best way to deal with our lack of sex life and the weight issues? She may be depressed, so consider that possibility when you approach her about your concerns.  Realize that she may have resentment about the situation, too, since you're so busy with your current professional burdens.  It doesn't fit the dreams of newlywed bliss she may have had, which actually happens for many women in today's society.  Make it clear beyond a doubt that your love is truly unconditional.  It sounds as if you two chose a difficult time in your lives to get married; but there are no "do-overs" in life, so what to do now?

Remind her that the certification process will be over at some point by talking about the positive effect it will have on your life (e.g. higher income, new job [maybe closer to home]).  Help keep her aware that you are doing what you do for your future TOGETHER.  Also, talk about things you'll be able to do with the time you'll have when you've completed the certification.  Try to use "us" and "we" more than "I" and "me" in your statements.  

If she's not happy about her weight gain, she probably isn't feeling very "sexy" and may be too self-conscious about it.  If you don't mind it, maybe say that you like her "curves" that it makes her more womanly.  Be flirtatious -- foreplay happens all day for women, because it's about feeling confident and desirable, as well as safe and comfortable.  So make sure she knows you still want her.

With the little free time you have, try doing physical activities like hiking or riding bikes.  Of course that will depend on what you both like to do and where you live, but you get the idea.  Since you are both cooking together, maybe suggest healthier meal selections.  Maybe there's a place on your way home from work where you could run in and grab some fresh veggies.  If she's a full-time student, she should have access to the gym facilities on campus - encourage her to spend some of her alone time there.  Or maybe she could get a part-time job or do some volunteer work to help improve her sense of self-confidence.  

Marriage really is a commitment, and yours is already being tested.  Hang in there, and keep your priorities straight.

how would i know that my chat sweet heart is lying??  Some online liars will tip their hands quickly, but the clever ones are hard to detect. That's a good reason to take your time before meeting your cybersweetheart. 
 
   
  Steps:  
1.   Communicate with your new flame privately and on message boards and chat rooms.  
  
2.   Allow the cyber-romance to develop slowly.  
  
3.   Avoid exchanging addresses or phone numbers for the first couple of weeks.  
  
4.   Watch for exaggeration or undue evasiveness in your cybersweetheart.  
  
5.   Question your friend about his or her job, education, hobbies and family.  
  
6.   Determine whether his or her expertise matches his or her supposed background.  
  
7.   Ask more probing questions about his or her location, family, past and job after a month.  
  
8.   Exchange pictures, but send them as files attached to e-mail or use a post office box. Decide whether his or her appearance matches the self-description he or she offered you.  
  
9.   Try phone calls only after the friendship has endured a few months.  
  
10.   Verify some of his or her story by using work phone numbers if possible.  
  
11.   Call his or her workplace when he or she is not there for further verification.  
  
12.   Arrange to meet in a public place if everything checks out. If not, say, "Good bye."  
  
  
  Tips:  
 Do not check your intuition at the door as you enter cyberspace.  
  
 Take notes on the comments your partner makes during chat sessions and save his or her e-mail. Check for contradictions as the relationship proceeds.  
  
  
  Warnings:  
 Never ignore your intuition about a cybersweetheart.  
  
 People who stubbornly refuse to reveal much about themselves should not be trusted.  
  
 Don't forget that you are dealing with a stranger in a medium where it is easy to lie.

Should stem cell research be legalized?  It is. The area of dispute is public funding vs. private funding. Currently only adult stem cells and a few fetal stem cell lines, most of which are unusable, are allowed to be used by firms with public funding.

The problem with the embryonic stem cell research debate is that too many people equate it with abortion. For years, publicly-funded researchers have been trying to use embryos from fertility clinics. The way the current law is, the ones that are not implanted in a woman are discarded - thrown in the trash. I see this as unethical. Why discard them when they can be used on possibly life-saving research? Who supports embryonic stem-cell research? People as diverse as Michael J Fox, Nancy Reagan, Curt Shilling, Muhammad Ali, Arlen Specter, and my father, who passed 4 years ago from Lou Gherigs disease.

I feel it is unethical to discard something that could potentially save lives simply because of misinformation.

Pluripotent stem cells, those from embryos, are able to develop into all the different types of cells in the body and multiply rapidly. 

Adult stem cells, or multipotent stem cells, that could give rise to all cell and tissue types have not yet been found. Adult stem cells are often present in only minute quantities and can therefore be difficult to isolate and purify. There is also evidence that they may not have the same capacity to multiply as embryonic stem cells do. Also, adult stem cells may contain more DNA abnormalities—caused by sunlight, toxins, and errors in making more DNA copies during the course of a lifetime. These potential weaknesses limit the usefulness of adult stem cells.

There is a really good paper on this at The Michael J Fox Foundation website called "Q&A Embryonic Stem Cells; Exploding the Myth" (see link)

Can you appeal a traffic ticket if you are found guilty in the trial??  Yes. That's what the appeal process is for. You appeal it to the County Court of Appeals in the county where the violation occurred. There should be instructions on the back of your copy explaining what to do. Usually, you have to file the appeal within a certain time period after the finding of the lower court. The county court of appeals is the final court on a traffic violation, but often easy to have overturned for numerous reasons. If the officer fails to show up and they try to reschedule your appearance, object to the prosecuting attorney, if he/she is not cooperative, ask to speak to the judge. Usually it will be automatically reversed and dismissed. If you have an attorney, he can examine the ticket and details of the incident      and suggest a defense. If you are defending yourself and have  any evidence, e.g.- picture of obscured stop sign, witness, etc, you can introduce that evidence and essentially have a new trial. If you are guilty and have no real defense, plead "no contest' if the officer shows up. Its the same as a guilty plea, but does not indicate that you admit guilt. You also will have chance to explain circumstances to the judge. In Texas, the fine is usually cut in half and sometimes dismissed if you attend defensive driving school. Call the court that heard your case and ask about process to file the appeal. You may have to post the amount of the fine as bond and sometimes more, which will be reimbursed upon   the appeal trial.

Two options - you can get a will kit from OfficeMax or other office supply store, or you can get the book/CD from Nolo Press (see link below).

For most people, nothing else is necessary.

If you simply write up  your wishes in clear hand-writing (not typed) this will also do. It doesn't even have to be witnessed or notarized. This is called a holographic will.

Use percentages to share out the estate, rather than amounts. That takes care of how values change over time - like "15% of my estate to Ralph".

You do not need to leave anything to the executor. If you name a company, then they can deduct their fees from the estate before distributing the money.

Don't over think it - you can't say 'rent out this property for two years'; those types of provisions can easily be overturned in the Probate Court. Keep it simple - percentages for primary beneficiaries, specific bequests of heirlooms (my mother's wedding ring to Sarah) and small amounts specified to minor beneficiaries ($500 to my dear friend George).

That should cover it! If you are using a will kit, or the Nolo Software/book, make note of the requirements for filing, witnesses and notarization - these change from state to state.

how long does a seller have to move after the closeing in louisiana. is the buyer allowed on the property.?  Depends upon the agreement you have between the two parties.  

The standard agreement specifies "at closing" meaning that the instant the paperwork is signed, the buyer has the right to immediate possession.  If the seller is still on the property, he or she is technically trespassing.

When the agreement states "at closing" the seller should move out a few days before the actual closing and surrender the keys to the closing agent (escrow company or attorney) so that they can be handed over to the buyer at closing.

If the seller will not be able to move out of the property for a period of time after closing, the parties need to negotiate possession as part of the agreement and include this in the agreement.  This agreement usually specifies a number of days that the seller may remain in the property and provides for payment of rent to the buyer for the term of the hold-over.  Common practice is to execute a short-term lease and attach it to the agreement as part of the closing documents.  In this case, the buyer has become a landlord, the seller a tenant, and the relationship between the parties is treated as any other tenant/landlord relationship.  

A landlord may generally inspect his property at reasonable hours upon giving notice to the tenant.  This notice is usually specified by state law or would be included in the lease agreement.  The buyer/landlord would not have a right to start moving their property into the house, redecorating, etc. until the seller/tenant vacated the property.

If the seller/tenant failed to vacate the property according to the terms of the agreement, the buyer/landlord would start normal eviciton proceedings.

what does sound bite mean?  WHAT IS A SOUND BITE?
Sound bites are the distillation of your message into a short phrase or sentence that is
both memorable and instantly provides a clear statement of your position even to the
reader or viewer who is totally unfamiliar with the issue you are addressing.
ELEMENTS OF A SOUNDBITE
Expresses the essential point – not details
A good sound bite gets to the core of the matter quickly. A sound bite is a
focused, succinct and brief statement. The sound bite does not provide context or detail.
The most common misconception people have in writing quote or sound bite
lines is the that they need to provide the context of the issue being addressed. A good sound
bite should be stripped of context and qualification. If a sound bite is intended to insert a quote into a newspaper
report or electronic broadcast you can count on the reporter to provide the context. A sound bite placed in the first
or second paragraph of a press release can be followed by whatever context or qualifications are needed. In an
interview, a sound bite opens the door to explaining the context and providing the facts that back up the message.
Stays on-message
It’s easy to write inflammatory sound bites. But a sound bite that’s over the top is also
off-message. A sound bite not only needs to be brief and memorable, it must also accurately
capture the essential message you and your organization want to communicate.
SOUND BITE TECHNIQUES
Alliteration: This is one of the easiest techniques to employ. Think of the word or
words that are central to your issue, then come up with like-sounding words that
can be used to craft your sound bite.
Example: The sound bite “a victory for wildlife over wildcatters and grassroots
over greed ” was picked up by the Associated Press in reporting a U.S. Senate
vote against opening the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge to oil drilling.
Analogy: Connecting your position to a well understood analogy is often a good way to craft a sound bite.
Example: “Sen. Horwith’s proposal is like a party balloon, colorful on the outside, but full of hot air on the
inside.”

Does Ca. law not require a written 30 days written notice before my belongings can be removed by landlord?  The applicable law is contained in Civil Code, Sections 1983 to 1991.
The landlord must store the property in a safe place (the
vacant apartment or some other storage facility) and protect it from theft, the elements, or other damage.

The landlord is entitled to reimbursement for storage costs and also for the personal effort in safe-guarding the abandoned personal property, such as security guards, etc., if such effort is reasonably necessary. 

The landlord must itemize and determine the value of the property abandoned. 

It is required that proper written notice be served upon the abandoning tenant and also upon any other person believed to be the owner of the abandoned personal property. This notice is to give concerned persons an adequate opportunity to reclaim their property.

The tenant should be given 18 days to reclaim the property upon payment of any costs for storing it, etc.

The landlord cannot “ransom” the claimed personal property for rent that is past due or for any property damage that was done.  The only payment that must be made by the former tenant or the property owner for them to be entitled to the release of the abandoned personal property is the cost of storage and safekeeping.

If the property is not claimed within the 18 day time period & it is valued at less than $300, the landlord may keep the abandoned personal property for his/her own use, or dispose of it in any manner desired including, but not limited to, selling, giving away, destroying, renting, etc.  

If the property is valued at more than $300, there must be a public auction with competitive bidding. Anyone may bid for the property including the landlord and even the tenant. Prior to the actual sale, the auction must be advertised in a newspaper of general circulation in the County where the sale will take place.
 
Any money realized from a public sale belongs to the tenant and not the landlord, even if rent or other money is owed. The only money that the landlord will realize from all the efforts of a public sale is reimbursement for the actual cost of storage, safekeeping, advertising and sale.  The balance, if not claimed by the former tenant or owner of the property, must be deposited with the treasury of the County in which the sale took place within thirty (30) days of the sale. After such deposit the former tenant or owner of the property must apply to the County for their money.

Is the U.S. the only country to institute a "national language"?  The US hasn't actually instituted a "national language" yet.  The measure was recently passed by the Senate, but has to go through House/Senate negotiations and be signed by the President.  

A "national language" is different from an "official language."  An official language means that gov't documents will only be printed in that language--a national language is more non-binding, just to recognize that most of us speak English. 

Most countries do have a national or official language, and very many have more than one officially recognized language.  

But the US is different from most countries.  For the most part, people in France are of French ancestry, people in Germany are of German ancestry -- but people in the US can be of English, French, German, Russian, Irish, Italian, Polish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Mexican, Guatemalan, Native American, or any other ancestry.  

I've lived overseas for four years now, and I have come to understand that the US is genuinely unique in this respect.  I think to establish English as our only language is denying our heritage--not just for recent immigrants, but for all of us whose ancestors, at some point, spoke another language.  That heritage is a vital part of what makes us different from the rest of the world and gives us our identity as "American."

 Rise to power 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Discharged from the hospital amid the social chaos that followed Germany's defeat, Hitler took up political work in Munich in May–June 1919. As an army political agent, he joined the small German Workers' Party in Munich (September 1919). In 1920 he was put in charge of the party's propaganda and left the army to devote himself to improving his position within the party, which in that year was renamed the National-sozialistische Deutsche Arbeiterpartei (Nazi). Conditions were ripe for the development of such a party. Resentment at the loss of the war and the severity of the peace terms added to the economic woes and brought widespread discontent. This was especially sharp in Bavaria, due to its traditional separatism and the region's popular dislike of the republican government in Berlin. In March 1920 a coup d'état by a few army officers attempted in vain to establish a right-wing government. 

Munich was a gathering place for dissatisfied former servicemen and members of the Freikorps, which had been organized in 1918–19 from units of the German army that were unwilling to return to civilian life, and for political plotters against the republic. Executions in Pennsylvania were carried out by hanging from the time the first colonists arrived in the late 1600s. In 1834, Pennsylvania became the first state in the union to abolish public hangings; and, for the next eight decades, each county was responsible for carrying out its own "private hangings" within the walls of its county jail. The responsibility for executing capital cases passed to the state in 1913 when the electric chair took the place of the gallows. 

The location of the chair selected by the state legislature was the new Western Penitentiary in Centre County, now known as the State Correctional Institution at Rockview. Although capital punishment by electrocution was authorized by legislation in 1913, neither the chair nor the institution were ready for occupancy until 1915. 

From 1915 until 1962, there were a total of 350 persons executed in the chair, two of whom were women. What was the conflict over the legislative power of the national government?  During the time of the Convention a number of issues were addressed.  One of the primary concerns was how was the Congress of the United States to be structured and how would the members gain membership.  The suggested approaches were from a single house with hereditary members to a bicameral congress with all members elected directly from the people.  

The final version was a bicameral congressional structure with the upper house membership comprised of two members from each State and these elected by the legislature of the State from which they come.  The lower house was to have members in numbers defined by population and this would result in each State having unique numbers of representatives, and these representatives would represent the people of a given district and only the citizens of that district could vote for that representative.  

In this process people would be represented by a single directly elected representative.  The States each represented by two representatives.

To carry this further, the President would be elected by delegates to the Electoral College and delegates would be elected in a manner singularly directed by each State.

The members of the Supreme Court would be selected by the President with advise and consent of the Senate.

The pattern here should be obvious, that is, popular election of these offices was not desired by the Founders.  Even the members of the lower house were elected by small districts within each State.

What is the future of the Balkans?  Romania and Bulgaria are Axis satellites; Greece and Yugoslavia are members of the United Nations; Albania is occupied territory; and Turkey has been a fairly consistent nonbelligerent. Bulgaria was happy with German permission to occupy Yugoslavian and Greek Macedonia and Thrace. Obedient to its master’s voice, Romania did not complain out loud when Hitler ordered the cession of northern Transylvania to Hungary in 1940. But Romania has not forgotten this enforced loss of territory, and underneath the surface of common membership in the Axis, Romania, Hungary, and Bulgaria are seething with territorial jealousies and ambitions. Greece and Yugoslavia are also insistent that their seized provinces shall be restored to them.

Such trouble spots as Transylvania, Thrace, Macedonia, Northern Epirus, Kossovo, and the Banat may be just words to other people. But to the people of the Balkans they have been fighting words. Much had been done before the war, however, to make boundary disputes less dangerous to peace. Only one of the six Balkan states, Bulgaria, was still unreconciled, and even Bulgaria had undertaken not to try to modify its frontiers by force of arms.

Added to these disputes between the nations are the internal divisions between various groups within (or exiled from) each country. That between the Chetniks and the Partisans is only the most spectacular and most publicized conflict. In Greece and Albania as well, struggles are in progress between the popular, forces of resistance and liberation on the one hand, and the elements of reaction and collaboration on the other, although the latter are almost negligible. The real fight is rather between bands with conflicting ideas of patriotism. Some people think there are pro-Allied movements in Bulgaria and Romania too, awaiting the opportunity to throw out pro-Axis governments. In all the Balkan countries, as in the rest of Europe, there are seeds of civil strife.

In this pamphlet, much of the blame for past Balkan troubles has been freely placed on the great powers. But of course they are not solely responsible.

Uncritical nationalism is particularly strong in the Balkans. And it is just in the Balkans, a small area crowded with many different peoples, that unbridled nationalist rivalry is perhaps most dangerous. The great powers have been as much motivated by nationalism as the small ones—and perhaps will continue to be. But if it is questionable whether they can afford to prolong a system in which aggressive nationalism is curbed only by the force of opposing nationalism, it is certain that the Balkan countries cannot afford it.

To put it the other way around, if the great powers have had to “recognize the necessity of establishing ... a general international organization ... for the maintenance of ... peace and security,” in the words of the Moscow Declaration, the Balkan nations are still more obliged to seek for peaceful ways of settling conflicts through cooperation or else destroy themselves.

Judges generally have discretion to recuse themselves from hearing any case in which they have a personal interest. Mostly this is done through random assignment to keep things fair.  However, for example, senior federal trial judges have the ability to say they don't want to take a particular sort of case... for example, criminal cases.  And if a judge has too crowded a docket, she can work with the clerk to have certain cases reassigned.  

Intermediate appeallate courts usually hear everything as well, although they can decide for themselves whether to do so in panels of just a few judges -- or en banc, which means a hearing before all the judges of a certain area.  

It's not quite true that state supreme courts and the USSC have absolute discretion which cases to hear.  For example, death penalty cases are often appealed as of right to state supreme courts.  And the USSC is the only place that certain disputes, like those between sovereign States, can be heard.  But generally speaking those judges do have a LOT more say over which cases they hear.

Hope that helps.
